successCriteria.description: The `LeaveRequestStatus` enum is exported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` and exposes exactly five members: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED — each with a distinct numeric or string value.

The `LeaveType` enum is exported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` and exposes exactly six members: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY, UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY — each with a distinct numeric or string value.

The `AuditAction` enum is exported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` and exposes exactly six members: CREATED, UPDATED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, DELETED — each with a distinct numeric or string value.
A Jest unit test file at `tests/unit/shared/types/index.test.ts` verifies each enum's member set and that all values within each enum are distinct (no duplicate values).
`npm run build` (i.e., `tsc --noEmit`) passes with zero type errors, and `npx jest --passWithNoTests` passes with all enum tests green.

constraints: The module at `src/shared/types/index.ts` must have zero imports from other project modules — it is the foundation with no dependencies.
TypeScript strict mode is enforced project-wide (`tsconfig.json` strict: true). No `any` types are permitted (HARNESS constraint `no-any`).
The file must use ES module export syntax (`export enum ...`) consistent with the project's source conventions, even though `tsconfig.json` targets `commonjs` module output.
The test file must follow the Jest configuration: `testMatch` pattern `**/tests/**/*.test.(ts|js)`, `ts-jest` transform, and `node` test environment.
outOfScope: The `BalanceStatus` enum (ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, CLOSED) — it is defined in Phase 5 within `src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts`, not in the shared types module.

Any model interfaces (LeaveRequest, LeavePolicy, LeaveBalance, Employee, AuditRecord, Notification), DTOs, repository interfaces, service interfaces, service implementations, controllers, or routes — all belong to later phases.
Database migrations, Knex configuration, seed data, or any runtime infrastructure — this phase is pure TypeScript types with no runtime behavior.

entityInvariants.invariant: The enum is a closed set of five lifecycle states: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED. No other values are valid for a LeaveRequest status. Every member value is distinct.

The enum is a closed set of six leave categories: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY, UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY. Every member value is distinct. The feature scope explicitly covers ANNUAL, SICK, and EMERGENCY; the remaining types are defined for completeness.

The enum is a closed set of six auditable actions: CREATED, UPDATED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, DELETED. Every member value is distinct. These values are used by the audit module to classify every state-changing operation.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `AuditAction` enum members must match the audit action names referenced in the reconciled architecture's business rules and the audit module's planned `AuditRecord.action` field. Specifically: CREATED, UPDATED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, DELETED.
The `LeaveRequestStatus` enum members must match the lifecycle states declared in the reconciled architecture's `LeaveRequest` entity: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED.
The `LeaveType` enum members must match the leave categories declared in the reconciled architecture's `LeaveType` entity: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY, UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY.
